editorial: We visited in early June, when Athens was pleasant, while Santorini was heating up in both celsius and crowds. Spring (April to June) is not the most popular time to visit, which is exactly why we recommend it!

Early autumn (September and October) has warm seas and thinning crowds, making it the next best time to drop in. A word of caution however… hospitality workers in the Aegean islands may be exhausted from the summer rush, so the quality of service may ever so slightly deteriorate.
Summer (July and August) is the most picturesque, but only go this time of the year if you want to party with half of Europe on a tiny island.
Winter (November to March) is low season, which means a lot of businesses in the islands shut shop.
